tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Request a free, no-obligation quote from Juicy Designs (a Pretoria digital marketing and design agency). Before calling, read the collected fields back to the user and get explicit confirmation, including consent to be contacted. Does not return a price: Juicy Designs replies with a custom proposal

tools.name: book_strategy_session
tools.description: Request a free, no-obligation strategy session with Juicy Designs. Confirm the user's details and consent before calling. Does not return a price or book a confirmed time; the team replies to arrange a session within four working hours.

tools.name: get_service_catalog
tools.description: List Juicy Designs services with a one-line summary and a reference 'from' floor where one exists. Figures are entry-point 'from' references only, not quotes or estimates. Pricing is scope-dependent and confirmed by a person in a written proposal within four working hours. Never present any figure a

tools.name: get_service_areas
tools.description: Where Juicy Designs works: head office, in-person areas, and remote coverage across South Africa.

tools.name: get_case_studies
tools.description: Juicy Designs track record and portfolio pointer. Agency-wide figures, not a guarantee of individual results.

tools.name: get_client_reviews
tools.description: Juicy Designs aggregate Google rating and where to read individual reviews. No reviews are generated here.

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Common questions and answers about quotes, pricing policy, contracts and how Juicy Designs works.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_quote" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
